beats.speaker: 旁白
beats.text: Rain starts. You and your friend go into a room. A child is there with a photo book. There is no room on the table.
beats.translation: 下雨了。你和同行的伙伴走进一间活动室。一个孩子抱着相册站在那里，桌上却没有地方放。

beats.speaker: 旁白
beats.text: Your friend finds a box. You put the paper in it. The child puts the book on the table and opens it. You move closer to look.
beats.translation: 伙伴找来一个盒子。你把桌上的纸收进去。孩子把相册放到桌上翻开，你凑近了看。

beats.speaker: 旁白
beats.text: The rain stops. The child closes the book with a smile. You all put the chairs back. Next time, you will bring a photo too.
beats.translation: 雨停了。孩子笑着合上相册。你们一起把椅子放回原处。下次，你也要带一张照片来。

beats.speaker: 旁白
beats.text: You and your friend go to a little art show. A child holds a picture. The other pictures are on the wall, but this one is still in the child's hands.
beats.translation: 你和同行的伙伴去看一个小画展。一个孩子拿着一张画。别人的作品都挂在墙上，只有这张还留在孩子手里。

beats.speaker: 旁白
beats.text: Your friend finds a space on the wall. You hold the picture there. The child puts it up. One corner curls up, so you gently press it flat.
beats.translation: 伙伴在墙上找到一块空处，你帮忙扶住画，孩子把它挂好。一只纸角翘了起来，你轻轻把它压平。

beats.speaker: 旁白
beats.text: Someone stops to look. The child stands by the picture and begins to talk. When you leave, the child waves. The picture stays with the others.
beats.translation: 有人停下来看画。孩子站在作品旁，开始讲自己的画。你们离开时，孩子挥了挥手。那张画稳稳地留在其他作品旁边。
